question: Among the electrode manufacturing technologies and cell chemistries for high-energy lithium-ion batteries whose improvements are estimated, which has the largest estimated energy density improvement?
rendered: According to Table 1 in "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries, page 10", the largest estimated energy density improvement is 325-350 Wh/kg, achieved through combining Si/C anodes with thick NMC 811 or NFA cathodes.
